<tspan x="1027.0" dy="0">ReLU / Dropout</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="994.0" y="773" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="994.0" dy="0">C[B,96,8],Q[B,96,5]; pair scoreS[B,8,5]; final channels4D=384.</tspan>
<tspan x="994.0" dy="16.52">Mask1 means padding; S1 normalizes query, S2 normalizes context.</tspan>
<tspan x="994.0" dy="16.52">One shared288-vector w scores all C/Q pairs; selected eval keeps Dropout node.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="994.0" y="847" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="994.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="994.0" y="877" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="994.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="994.0" y="902" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="994.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
